quickAnswerHtml: Signature is a One MICHELIN Star restaurant in the MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026, in Ratchathewi (VIE Hotel, 11th floor). Budget around the "Flower Bouquet" set, 5 courses THB 4,800++ / , book through SevenRooms, and get there via BTS Ratchathewi

blocks.html:
If you had to pick one French restaurant in Bangkok that tells its story through "flowers" in the most committed way, it would be Signature, on the 11th floor of VIE Hotel Bangkok – MGallery in Ratchathewi. This is the new home of Chef Thierry Drapeau, a French chef who once held a 2-star MICHELIN restaurant in France before relocating to Bangkok to pursue a "floral/terroir" style of cooking. The result is one MICHELIN star retained for a fourth consecutive year in the 2026 guide, and that's no accident — what MICHELIN singles out for praise is the use of herbs and edible flowers that speak to each ingredient's origin. Eating through the menu feels like the chef is narrating what kind of soil, what kind of air, each element came from before landing on the plate.

The restaurant's signature menu is called "Flower Bouquet," built around the concept of a bouquet of flowers. It comes as a 5-course set at THB 4,800++ or an 8-course set at THB 5,800++, plus a 5-course vegetarian set at THB 4,800++ for guests who don't eat meat — not an easy find at this level of fine dining. Anyone who wants to go all out can add the beverage pairing at THB 3,200++ for the 5-course set or THB 3,900++ for the 8-course set. The menu changes with the seasons, so a different visit means a different bouquet. The room itself is an Art Deco dining space with an open kitchen, so you can watch the chefs work while you eat, and if you can book a window table, you get a night view of Bangkok on top of everything else.

Another reason this restaurant is more appealing than it first sounds is location. People tend to assume French fine dining has to be tucked down some deep soi or in an upscale neighbourhood you can only reach by taxi through traffic, but Signature sits right next to BTS Ratchathewi station — under a 5-minute walk (just 2 minutes from the exit to the hotel lobby). Get off the train, take the lift to the 11th floor, and you're there — ideal for a special night when you don't want to risk running late because of traffic. The restaurant is dinner-only, Tuesday to Sunday, 18:00–23:30, with last seating at 20:45, and closed Mondays. Simple rule of thumb: if you want the easiest-to-reach MICHELIN star in Bangkok, this restaurant is right near the top of the list.

blocks.name: Signature
blocks.descHtml:
Budget starts with the "Flower Bouquet" set — 5 courses at THB 4,800++ / 8 courses at THB 5,800++ — plus a 5-course vegetarian set at THB 4,800++, and you can add the beverage pairing at THB 3,200++ / 3,900++. Booking runs through SevenRooms via the official link from the VIE Hotel website, or by phone at +66 6 5950 9742 / email info@signaturebangkok.com; a package is also sold on Klook as another option. The key tip is the notes field when booking — type in a request for a window table with a city view; that section is the best seating in the house.

Getting there is surprisingly easy for a MICHELIN-starred restaurant, since VIE Hotel sits right next to BTS Ratchathewi station — just a 2-minute walk from the station up to the 11th floor. The restaurant is dinner-only, Tuesday–Sunday, 18:00–23:30, closed Mondays, with last seating at 20:45. Arriving around 18:00–18:30 is recommended so you catch the evening light through to the night view, and have time to enjoy the 8-course set without rushing.

faq.q: How do I book Signature? Do I need to book ahead?
faq.a: Book through SevenRooms via the official link on the VIE Hotel website, or by phone at +66 6 5950 9742 / email info@signaturebangkok.com; a package is also sold on Klook as another option. When booking, put in a request for a window table with a city view in the notes

The "Flower Bouquet" set is 5 courses at THB 4,800++ / 8 courses at THB 5,800++, plus a 5-course vegetarian set at THB 4,800++. Adding the beverage pairing brings it up another THB 3,200++ (5 courses) or THB 3,900++ (8 courses)

This is a pure tasting-menu restaurant built around the "Flower Bouquet" concept — if you have the time, go for the 8-course set to get the full range of Chef Thierry Drapeau's floral/terroir work. The menu changes with the seasons, so a repeat visit means a new bouquet

faq.q: How do I get there, and what time should I go?
faq.a: Take the BTS to Ratchathewi station, walk just 2 minutes to VIE Hotel, then head up to the 11th floor. The restaurant is dinner-only, Tuesday–Sunday, 18:00–23:30 (closed Mondays), with last seating at 20:45. Going around 18:00–18:30 gets you both the evening light and the night view
